related.title: WaveNet：因果擴張與聲音上下文
related.titleEn: WaveNet: causal dilation and audio context
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付門控端點表、突變響應與狀態接口測試。；.55與.05正確且端點測試通過，公式慣例寫入介面契約。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver gate endpoints, change responses and state-interface tests.; Results.55 and.05 match, endpoint tests pass and the convention is documented.
related.difference: 畫最後樣本往前的因果依賴樹；每層只連當下或過去，不連未來。；256與512可重算，16與32ms換算正確且未來擾動測試通過。
related.differenceEn: Draw the final sample’s dependency tree with only current or past connections.; Counts and durations match and future-perturbation tests pass.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 採h新=z h舊+(1−z)候選的慣例；不同命名可反轉z，必須與實作一致。；教學h舊=.8、候選=−.2,z=.75；改z=.25。；h新=.75×.8+.25×(−.2)=.55；z.25時.05。
核寬2、擴張率1,2,…,2^(L−1)時，感受野1+Σd=2^L個樣本。；教學L=8，取樣率16000Hz；改L=9。；R=2^8=256樣本；L9時512樣本，分別16及32ms。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Use h_new=z h_old+(1−z)candidate; alternate naming may reverse z and must match implementation.; Teaching old state.8,candidate−.2,z.75 then.25.; h_new=.75×.8+.25×(−.2)=.55; z.25 gives.05.

With width-two kernels and dilations1,2,…,2^(L−1), receptive field is1+Σd=2^L samples.; Teaching eight layers at16000Hz, then nine layers.; R=2^8=256 samples; nine layers give512, corresponding to16 and32ms.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: AdamW：解耦權重衰減
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付門控端點表、突變響應與狀態接口測試。；.55與.05正確且端點測試通過，公式慣例寫入介面契約。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver gate endpoints, change responses and state-interface tests.; Results.55 and.05 match, endpoint tests pass and the convention is documented.
related.difference: 畫梯度路與衰減路兩支，標哪些參數群組排除衰減；本例只含一個普通權重。；1.998與1.996吻合，零梯度/None差異與群組設定有紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Draw gradient and decay paths; identify excluded parameter groups, with one ordinary weight in this example.; Values match and zero/None behavior and group settings are documented.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 採h新=z h舊+(1−z)候選的慣例；不同命名可反轉z，必須與實作一致。；教學h舊=.8、候選=−.2,z=.75；改z=.25。；h新=.75×.8+.25×(−.2)=.55；z.25時.05。
在顯式零梯度且先前兩個Adam動量皆為零的示例中θ新=(1−ηλ)θ；若舊動量非零仍有梯度路更新。衰減不先混入動量。；教學θ2,η.01,λ.1；顯式梯度及先前兩個動量皆為0；改λ.2。；θ新=(1−.01×.1)×2=1.998；改後1.996。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Use h_new=z h_old+(1−z)candidate; alternate naming may reverse z and must match implementation.; Teaching old state.8,candidate−.2,z.75 then.25.; h_new=.75×.8+.25×(−.2)=.55; z.25 gives.05.

With an explicit zero gradient and both prior Adam moments zero,theta_new=(1−eta lambda)theta; nonzero prior moments still produce an adaptive update. Decay does not first enter the moments.; Teaching theta2,learning rate.01,decay.1 then.2,with an explicit zero gradient and both prior moments zero.; theta_new=(1−.01×.1)×2=1.998; changed result1.996.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
